decisions.reason: Since A is a low-cost variant close to the established offer and no negative signal has emerged, the option value of waiting still exceeds carrying cost.
The renewed gold medal strongly signals realized value, so the option is almost certainly worthwhile and a drop is very unlikely.
Like other bread variants, C has unresolved demand but low incremental cost, so the firm retains the option.
D is more niche and has no positive signal, but its carrying cost is still low enough to justify keeping the option for now.
E is a seasonal stollen without an external award, so its value is more uncertain, yet the option remains cheap to hold for another season.
The vague "Meisterstück" promotion suggests positive but not decisive demand, and unresolved uncertainty with low cost favors keeping.
